Name: Hitman HD Pack
Overview:
The Hitman HD Pack (also known as the Hitman HD Trilogy) for Xbox 360 is a high-definition remastered collection that compiles three foundational games from the franchise into a single package. 
Included Titles & Storylines
The collection spans over 40 missions, covering Agent 47's career from 2002 to 2006. 

Hitman 2: Silent Assassin: Agent 47 attempts to retire to a monastery but is lured back into the life of an assassin by a Russian crime boss after his mentor, Father Vittorio, is kidnapped.

Hitman: Contracts: While wounded and hallucinating in a hotel room, Agent 47 relives past missions. This title serves as a partial reimagining of the original PC-only Hitman: Codename 47.

Hitman: Blood Money: Agent 47 goes up against a rival organization known as "The Franchise." This title is widely considered a series highlight for its open-ended sandbox levels and refined mechanics.
